quotes.author: Familyfaithfriends
quotes.text: My family and I had a wonderful boat cruise to Cabbage Key. On the way, Lee gave us information about the local areas. He was extremely pleasant, and we enjoyed talking with him. On the way to the island, we saw a small pod of dolphins. Once we arrived at Cabbage Key, we had a delicious hamburger for lunch. On the boat ride back, we were in seventh heaven. We had a pod of 10 or so dolphins swimming right behind us. It was amazing to be so close to these beautiful creatures. It was unbelievable! Well worth the trip!!! We would definitely go on another cruise with Captain Lee!

quotes.author: P. Corbin
quotes.text: My wife, my sister and I took the cruise to Cabbage Key and absolutely loved every minute of it! Phil did a great job at the wheel and Will was an excellent tour guide pointing out many places of interest and telling us much of the history. Of course, the highlight was the dolphins playing and jumping in the boat’s wake. We had just enough time on the island to enjoy a delicious lunch and explore some and relax some. We highly recommend Boca Boat Cruises! Five stars!

quotes.author: Synergy HC
quotes.text: Get off the beach, and get on the most fun boat tour in Florida. The experienced, friendly captains make the entire "crew" comfortable. They showed our family, celebrating our Mom's 80th birthday, the most amazing dolphin show we have ever seen. Thank you so much for an epically memorable day. Now that we know you're there, we'll be back. Best Regards!.
